query: *[_type == "post" && defined(slug.current) && defined(image.asset) && ("bintang" in restaurants || title match "bintang" || summary match "bintang" || pt::text(body) match "bintang")] | order(date desc, _createdAt desc) { kind, "slug": slug.current, title, date, summary, restaurants, category, url, "outlet": outlet->name, "image": image{ alt, "asset": asset->{ _id, url, "w": metadata.dimensions.width, "h": metadata.dimensions.height } } }

menus.query: *[_type == "menu" && _id in $ids]{ "id": _id, restaurant, title, sections[]{ part, title, subtitle, intro, priceLabel, foot, boxed, wide, items[]{ name, price, description, note, dietary, hide } } }
